name: Shiro Densetsu
source:
It is the land of conflict. Red and blue people fight each other day after day. White people appeared - "We shall rule this land". Can you proclame leadership over the land as a white man?

[From [url=http://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/04/vn-of-year-1984.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
这是一片战乱不休的大地。红族与蓝族日复一日地争斗，此时白族现身宣告：“我们将统治这片土地。”身为白族一员的你，能否当上这片土地的统治者？

[引自[url=http://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/04/vn-of-year-1984.html]vndbreview[/url]]
